seo.title: 40 Portfolio Project Ideas for Web3 Product Managers
seo.description: Discover portfolio project ideas for Web3 product managers. From case studies to community experiments, build a portfolio that demonstrates Web3 product expertise.

content.intro: Web3 product management requires demonstrating strategic thinking, community understanding, and technical literacy. These projects help you build a portfolio that shows real Web3 PM skills.

sections.heading: Case Studies and Analysis
sections.description: Demonstrate analytical thinking through deep dives.

items.title: Protocol Deep Dive
items.description: Comprehensive analysis of a major protocol: mechanics, tokenomics, governance, and growth strategy.

items.title: Post-mortem Analysis
items.description: Analyze a failed Web3 product. What went wrong and how could it have been prevented?

items.title: Competitive Analysis
items.description: Compare competing protocols in a category (DEXs, lending, bridges). Identify moats and vulnerabilities.

items.title: Token Launch Analysis
items.description: Study successful and failed token launches. What made the difference?

items.title: DAO Governance Study
items.description: Analyze governance participation and outcomes for a major DAO.

items.title: UX Audit
items.description: Conduct a thorough UX audit of a dApp. Identify pain points and propose improvements.

sections.heading: Product Strategy Documents
sections.description: Create strategic documents that show PM thinking.

items.title: PRD for a DeFi Feature
items.description: Write a product requirements document for a new DeFi protocol feature.

items.title: Product Roadmap
items.description: Create a 12-month roadmap for an existing protocol with milestones and priorities.

items.title: Go-to-Market Strategy
items.description: Develop a GTM strategy for a hypothetical Web3 product launch.

items.title: Tokenomics Design
items.description: Design token economics for a hypothetical protocol with utility, distribution, and incentives.

items.title: Feature Prioritization Framework
items.description: Create a framework for prioritizing features in a Web3 context.

items.title: User Persona Development
items.description: Create detailed personas for different Web3 user segments.

sections.heading: Community Experiments
sections.description: Learn by doing with real community involvement.

items.title: Run a Discord Community
items.description: Start and grow a Discord for a Web3 topic. Learn community management hands-on.

items.title: DAO Participation Portfolio
items.description: Document your active participation in DAOs: proposals, votes, discussions.

items.title: Write a Governance Proposal
items.description: Write and submit a real governance proposal to a DAO.

items.title: Community Feedback Program
items.description: Design and run a user feedback program for an open source Web3 project.

items.title: Ambassador Program Design
items.description: Design an ambassador program for a protocol with tiers, rewards, and responsibilities.

items.title: Protocol Metrics Dashboard
items.description: Build a Dune dashboard tracking key metrics for a protocol.

items.title: User Journey Analysis
items.description: Map and analyze on-chain user journeys for a dApp using transaction data.

items.title: Cohort Retention Analysis
items.description: Analyze user retention by cohort for a DeFi protocol.

items.title: Product Health Metrics
items.description: Define and track product health metrics for a Web3 protocol.

items.title: Growth Experiment Analysis
items.description: Analyze the impact of a protocol's growth initiative using on-chain data.

items.title: Web3 PM Newsletter
items.description: Start a newsletter covering Web3 product management topics.

items.title: Twitter Thread Series
items.description: Create educational Twitter threads on Web3 product topics.

items.title: Podcast Guest Circuit
items.description: Appear on Web3 podcasts to discuss product topics. Document your appearances.

items.title: Tutorial Series
items.description: Create tutorials teaching others how to use Web3 products effectively.

items.title: Market Trend Reports
items.description: Publish regular reports on Web3 market trends and opportunities.

sections.heading: Technical Understanding
sections.description: Demonstrate technical literacy without being an engineer.

items.title: Smart Contract Reading
items.description: Document your ability to read and explain smart contract logic.

items.title: Technical Architecture Diagrams
items.description: Create architecture diagrams for major protocols showing system design.

items.title: Integration Requirements Doc
items.description: Write integration requirements for connecting two protocols.

items.title: Security Consideration Guide
items.description: Create a security considerations checklist for PM evaluation of features.

items.title: Gas Optimization Case Study
items.description: Study and document how a protocol optimized gas costs with product implications.

gettingStarted.title: Use Web3 products daily
gettingStarted.description: You cannot PM products you don't understand as a user.

gettingStarted.title: Learn to read data
gettingStarted.description: Basic Dune Analytics skills are essential for Web3 PMs.

gettingStarted.title: Participate in DAOs
gettingStarted.description: Governance participation teaches you community dynamics.

gettingStarted.title: Build in public
gettingStarted.description: Share your analyses and learnings. Build a reputation.

gettingStarted.title: Network with builders
gettingStarted.description: Understanding engineering constraints makes you a better PM.
